title: yucca harrimaniae subsp. gilbertiana
intro: Yucca harrimaniae subsp. gilbertiana, commonly known as Gilbert's yucca, is a plant species belonging to the Asparagaceae family. It is native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and it is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Gilbert's yucca include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antioxidant and antimicrobial properties.
